address: 7 Soi Yen Akat 3, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok, 10120, Thailand
bio: A Nordic god on the fine-dining scene, Chef Frantzén now has an outpost in Bangkok. The swanky villa’s interior is inspired by modern Nordic aesthetics; with an open kitchen, granite floors and huge windows framing lush greens and exotic plants. His modern Nordic style borrows from Asian influences. With eccentric visual detail, every dish delivers a subtle complexity that accentuates the natural flavours of the ingredients. Advanced bookings are essential....
